Food: A Food token is an artifact with “{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: You gain 3 life.”
Discover: Exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a nonland card with mana value N or less. You may cast it without paying its mana cost or put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom in a random order.
Abandon: To abandon a scheme, turn a face-up ongoing scheme card face down and put it on the bottom of its owner’s scheme deck. (Archenemy only.)
Explore: Reveal the top card of your library. If it’s a land, put it into your hand. Otherwise, put a +1/+1 counter on the exploring creature and you may put the revealed card into your graveyard.
Treasure: A Treasure token is an artifact with “{T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add one mana of any color.”
Roll to Visit Your Attractions: Roll a six-sided die. Each Attraction you control with a lit number matching the result is visited, triggering “When you visit” abilities.
Set in motion: To set a scheme in motion, move it off the top of your scheme deck if it’s on top of the deck and turn it face up if it isn’t face up. (Archenemy only.)
Fateseal: Look at the top N cards of an opponent’s library, then you may put any number of them on the bottom of that library and the rest back on top in any order.
Manifest: Put the top card of your library onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature. You may turn it face up any time by paying its mana cost if it’s a creature card.
Populate: Create a token that’s a copy of a creature token you control.
Detain: Until your next turn, that permanent can’t attack or block and its activated abilities can’t be activated.
Investigate: Create a Clue token. (It’s an artifact with “{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Draw a card.”)
Monstrosity: {Cost}: If this creature isn’t monstrous, put N +1/+1 counters on it and it becomes monstrous.
Clash: Each clashing player reveals the top card of their library, then puts it on top or bottom. A player wins the clash if their revealed card has higher mana value.
Scry: Look at the top N cards of your library. Put any number on the bottom and the rest on top in any order.
Incubate: Create an Incubator token with N +1/+1 counters on it. It has “{2}: Transform this artifact.” (It becomes a 0/0 Phyrexian artifact creature and keeps the counters.)
Proliferate: Choose any number of players and/or permanents with counters on them. Give each another counter of a kind already there.
Meld: To meld two permanents, exile them, then return them to the battlefield melded into the combined card’s back face (as instructed).
Convert: On converting double-faced cards, to convert means to transform it to its other face.
Fight: Each of two creatures deals damage equal to its power to the other.
Bolster: Choose a creature you control with the least toughness (or tied). Put N +1/+1 counters on it.
Assemble: In Unstable, assemble a Contraption means put the top card of your Contraption deck onto one of your sprockets.
Conjure: Conjure means create a card (not from your deck) and put it into the stated zone. (Digital-only mechanic.)
Amass: If you don’t control an Army, create a 0/0 Army token. Put N +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Cloak: Put the top card of your library onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature with ward {2}. Turn it face up any time by paying its mana cost if it’s a creature card.
Suspect: A suspected creature can’t block and has menace.
Collect evidence: To collect evidence N, exile cards from your graveyard with total mana value N or greater.
Role token: Create the specified Role Aura token and attach it to a creature as instructed. (Role Auras are enchantments that grant abilities and are usually controlled by the creature’s controller.)
Plot: You may pay this card’s plot cost to exile it “plotted” as a sorcery. On a later turn, you may cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Forage: You may exile three cards from your graveyard or sacrifice a Food. If you do, you’ve foraged.
Manifest dread: Look at the top two cards of your library. Manifest one of them, then put the cards you looked at that weren’t manifested this way into your graveyard.
Endure: If a permanent endures N, its controller may put N +1/+1 counters on it. If they don’t, they create an N/N white Spirit creature token.
Behold: Behold a [quality] means reveal a [quality] card from your hand or choose a [quality] permanent you control on the battlefield.
Waterbend: Waterbend [cost] means pay that cost; for each {1} in that cost, you may tap an untapped artifact or creature you control rather than pay that mana.
Airbend: To airbend permanents and/or spells, exile them. For each card exiled this way, for as long as it remains exiled, its owner may cast it by paying {2} rather than paying its mana cost.
Earthbend: Earthbend N — Target land you control becomes a 0/0 land creature with haste in addition to its other types. Put N +1/+1 counters on it. When that land dies or is put into exile, return it to the battlefield tapped under your control.
